ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 90:10 ratio of low-intensity black pixels to high-intensity white/gray markings across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black background with high-contrast, light-gray circular mottle blobs localized in the central-left lobe and sparse linear high-intensity tracks across both lobes; a distinct high-intensity circular ring is located on the lower-left quadrant near the notch.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, narrow V-shaped depression with a calculated interior pixel angle of approximately 45 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, high-amplitude irregular jagged peaks at the distal end of the right lobe; low-frequency, low-amplitude undulations along the trailing boundary of the left lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex parabolic curves extending from the central notch to the lateral tips on both the left and right lobes.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple high-contrast circular pixel clusters (5-20 pixels in diameter) consistent with barnacle scar localization, concentrated on the medial region of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple high-contrast, unaligned linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) extending vertically and diagonally across the left lobe and diagonally on the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extreme structural irregularity and jagged tissue loss at the terminal tip of the right lobe, indicating significant past trauma or amputation.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, high-contrast white ring-shaped pixel formation (hollow circle) located on the lower-medial section of the left lobe.
